hooks.name: Update docs on stop
hooks.description: When a session completes, review what changed this session and update the docs (README, DESIGN.md, module docstrings/comments where warranted) so they stay accurate. Keep edits lean and only where the change actually affects documented behavior.

action.prompt:
Review the changes made in this session and update documentation so it stays accurate. Specifically:
- If public behavior, setup steps, env vars, commands, or architecture changed, update README.md and DESIGN.md (if present) to match.
- Keep documentation lean and human-sounding per the dev-best-practices steering — no narrating comments, no meta-commentary, document the why when it isn't obvious.
- Do NOT create new doc files unless a documented surface genuinely needs one. Do NOT restate the code.
- If nothing user-facing changed, make no edits and say so briefly.
Only touch docs; do not change source or tests in this pass.
